records.title: Toy sequence task
records.text: Derive the sum of the first n positive odd integers, for nonnegative integer n.

records.title: Arithmetic progression identity
records.text: A finite arithmetic progression has sum equal to its number of terms multiplied by the mean of its endpoints.

contribution_analysis.problem_and_context: Evaluate a finite arithmetic progression under the usual integer arithmetic assumptions.
contribution_analysis.contribution_and_value: The known endpoint-average identity gives the sum from the number of terms and the two endpoints.
contribution_analysis.relation_to_project: The toy odd-integer task applies this known identity. Its role is to demonstrate evidence attribution and protocol execution, with no original scientific contribution claimed.

records.title: Original toy argument
records.text: For n odd integers the endpoints average to n, giving n squared.
